canDoYue: 你識比較預繳同無限計劃，仲識開通電話卡。
canDoEn: Compare a prepaid plan with an unlimited plan, then activate a SIM.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello. Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。邊個電話計劃適合市區短途？
dialogue.say: Hello. Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: The prepaid plan costs less and covers the city.
dialogue.glossYue: 預繳計劃平啲，亦都覆蓋市區。
dialogue.say: The prepaid plan costs less and covers the city.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I'll take the prepaid one. I don't need unlimited data.
dialogue.glossYue: 我要預繳嗰個。唔使無限數據。
dialogue.say: I'll take the prepaid one. I don't need unlimited data.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: Please show me your passport so I can activate your SIM card.
dialogue.glossYue: 麻煩畀我睇你本護照，等我幫你開通電話卡。
dialogue.say: Please show me your passport so I can activate your sim card.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Here's my passport. Can I add more data later?
dialogue.glossYue: 我本護照喺度。我之後可唔可以再加數據？
dialogue.say: Here's my passport. Can I add more data later?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: Yes. You can buy a small top-up at any time.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。你隨時都可以增值少少。
dialogue.say: Yes. You can buy a small top-up at any time.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I'll pay for this prepaid SIM card here.
dialogue.glossYue: 我喺呢度畀錢買呢張預繳電話卡。
dialogue.say: I'll pay for this prepaid sim card here.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: The coverage on this SIM is enough for the city.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張卡嘅覆蓋夠市區用。
dialogue.say: The coverage on this sim is enough for the city.
